subtraditions.name: Theravada Buddhism
subtraditions.description: Traditions especially prominent in Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia, with Pali liturgical use and distinctive commentarial inheritance. Communities within this stream differ.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Mahayana Buddhism
subtraditions.description: A diverse Buddhist stream encompassing schools across Central and East Asia. The cited overview includes Pure Land and Zen and treats Vajrayana as part of Mahayana.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Vajrayana Buddhism
subtraditions.description: An esoteric Buddhist stream that developed within Mahayana. Its prominence in Tibet does not make it exclusive to Tibet; the source also notes forms in China and Japan.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Pure Land traditions
subtraditions.description: A family of Mahayana schools identified in the cited overview. Individual communities, languages and practices require their own records.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Zen traditions
subtraditions.description: A family of Mahayana schools identified in the cited overview. This umbrella entry does not equate all regional lineages or replace their own names.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Vaishnava traditions
subtraditions.description: One of the devotional streams identified in the cited Hinduism overview. Devotional streams coexist with philosophical traditions and are not an exhaustive classification of Hindu practice.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Shaiva traditions
subtraditions.description: A devotional stream within the diverse Hindu traditions described by the source. This entry does not imply one uniform institution, canon or community.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Shakta traditions
subtraditions.description: A devotional stream identified alongside Vaishnava and Shaiva traditions. A broad stream label does not supply a community-specific canon or complete history.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Sunni traditions
subtraditions.description: An Islamic tradition whose historical differentiation from Shi’i communities involves questions of leadership and authority. Specific legal schools and communities require further classification.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Shi’i traditions
subtraditions.description: An Islamic tradition distinguished in the source through debates over leadership and authority. The label contains further diversity; it is not a single legal school or institution.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Sufi movements
subtraditions.description: Devotional and mystical movements that cross divisions within Islam. This relationship is not an assertion of a mutually exclusive third denomination beside Sunni and Shi’i traditions.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Catholic traditions
subtraditions.description: One broad Christian stream in the cited overview. The three-stream outline is introductory and does not exhaust Christian diversity or settle theological claims.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Orthodox Christian churches
subtraditions.description: A broad family label used by the cited overview. Particular churches require separate records and must not be treated as a single institution.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Protestant movements
subtraditions.description: A diverse Christian stream in the cited overview, containing many churches and movements. The source warns that broad categories cannot capture the full range of Christian communities.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Sumerian religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Religious traditions of Sumerian-speaking city-states. This navigation record does not imply a single timeless pantheon or institution across cities and periods.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; city- and period-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Akkadian religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Akkadian-language religious worlds that interacted with and reinterpreted Sumerian traditions. Language, polity, deity name and cult identity must remain separately researchable.

sourceRefs.title: Guide to the Collections: Ancient Near Eastern Art

subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; city- and period-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Babylonian religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Religious traditions associated with Babylonian polities and communities. Political prominence and changes in divine hierarchy require period-specific evidence.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; city- and period-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Assyrian religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Religious traditions associated with Assyrian communities and polities. This record does not equate imperial history with all community practice.

sourceRefs.title: Assyria to Iberia at the Dawn of the Classical Age

subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; city- and period-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Ancient Egyptian temple cults
subtraditions.description: Temple-centered service to deities through priestly ritual, offerings and processions. Local cults, access rules and historical periods require separate records.

sourceRefs.title: The Temple of Dendur: Architecture and Ritual

subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked practice context; local and chronological coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Ancient Egyptian funerary traditions
subtraditions.description: Diverse preparations, rites and material practices concerning death and hoped-for transformation. Funerary evidence is not a complete description of everyday religion.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked practice context; social and chronological coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Ancient Egyptian domestic and personal religion
subtraditions.description: Household and personal religious practice, including protective objects and appeals connected with daily concerns. It must not be inferred solely from elite temple texts.

sourceRefs.title: The Art of Ancient Egypt: A Resource for Educators

subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked practice context; household and regional coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Ru / Confucian traditions
subtraditions.description: Scholarly, ethical and ritual traditions often labeled Confucianism. The source notes that the Western label and classification as religion are themselves historically contested.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; terminology and community coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Daoist traditions
subtraditions.description: A diverse family of philosophical, religious, priestly and cultivation traditions that has interacted with popular religion, Confucian traditions and Buddhism.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; school and community coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Chinese Buddhist traditions
subtraditions.description: Buddhist traditions developed in Chinese cultural settings through translation, institutions and interaction with other Chinese traditions. They belong in both regional and Buddhist navigation.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; school and historical coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Chinese popular and local religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Local, household and temple practices that may overlap Daoist, Buddhist and Confucian contexts. This record is deliberately nonexclusive and not a residual category for unknown material.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; local community coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Ethiopia, Eritrea and Horn religious worlds
subtraditions.description: A regional navigation sphere for distinct Christian, Jewish, Islamic and local histories. It is not a single tradition or uniform community.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked regional navigation; community coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church
subtraditions.description: An Ethiopian Christian church tradition with Geʿez liturgical and manuscript heritage. Institutional self-description and independent scholarship remain separately sourced.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; canon and community review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Eritrean Orthodox Tewahedo Church
subtraditions.description: A distinct Eritrean Orthodox Tewahedo church tradition cross-linked to the wider Tewahedo and Christian contexts without collapsing its institution into Ethiopian records.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked institutional metadata; canon and community review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Beta Israel traditions
subtraditions.description: Jewish religious and community traditions historically rooted in Ethiopia. Competing origin histories must remain attributed rather than resolved by the navigation taxonomy.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community and scholarship review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Islamic traditions of the Horn of Africa
subtraditions.description: Diverse Islamic communities and scholarly traditions of the Horn. Trade, conversion, language, local institutions and political history require separate sourced records.

sourceRefs.title: Becoming Muslim: Conversion to Islam and Islamisation in Eastern Ethiopia

subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked research context; community and regional coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Haudenosaunee religious and ceremonial traditions
subtraditions.description: Traditions of the Haudenosaunee nations in which ceremonial, oral, political and community life interrelate. Public introductory coverage does not authorize restricted knowledge intake.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Public source-checked introduction; community protocol review required for deeper intake

subtraditions.name: Maya religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Diverse ancient and living Maya traditions across many communities and languages. Shared historical features do not make Maya religion one centralized institution.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; living-community review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Mexica religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Religious traditions of the Mexica, also widely called Aztec in later scholarship. Self-name, later label, polity and broader Nahua identity remain distinct metadata.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; colonial-source review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Mixtec / Ñudzavui traditions
subtraditions.description: Religious and historical traditions associated with Mixtec or Ñudzavui communities. The dual label is retained pending deeper community-specific naming review.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; naming and community review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Zapotec traditions
subtraditions.description: Religious, ancestral and material traditions associated with Zapotec communities and historical sites. Archaeological culture and living community identity must not be conflated.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; living-community review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Yoruba religious traditions
subtraditions.description: Religious traditions of Yoruba communities in West Africa and their historical relationships with multiple diasporic traditions. Diasporic traditions remain distinct records.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community and lineage coverage incomplete

subtraditions.name: Fon and Ewe Vodun traditions
subtraditions.description: West African Vodun traditions associated with Fon and Ewe contexts. They must remain distinct from, while historically related to, Haitian Vodou and other diasporic traditions.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked relationship context; direct community-source review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Native Hawaiian religious and cultural traditions
subtraditions.description: Native Hawaiian traditions in which genealogy, land, performance, healing and sacred practice interrelate. Public evidence does not authorize restricted ceremonial content.

sourceRefs.title: Navigating the Ways of the Waʻa
sourceRefs.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

subtraditions.reviewStatus: Public source-checked introduction; community protocol review required for deeper intake

subtraditions.name: Māori religious and cultural traditions
subtraditions.description: Diverse Māori traditions carried through oral histories, communities, ritual specialists and performance. Historical recordings require recorder, translation and community-context review.

sourceRefs.title: Polynesian mythology and ancient traditional history of the Maori as told by their priests and chiefs

subtraditions.reviewStatus: Catalog source identified; community protocol and edition review required before content intake

subtraditions.name: Bahá’í Faith
subtraditions.description: A religious tradition emerging in nineteenth-century Iran with its own writings, institutions, calendar and global communities.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; institutional and independent-source depth incomplete

subtraditions.name: New Age movements
subtraditions.description: A varied family of late twentieth-century movements and practices. This umbrella label does not imply a central authority, single membership or uniform doctrine.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; movement-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Spiritual but not religious identities and practices
subtraditions.description: A contemporary self-description spanning varied beliefs and practices. It is not a church, denomination or claim that all unaffiliated people share one worldview.
